spec_match.rationale: Steps, enum values (IntelligentScanModelType, NoInfoReason, IntelligentScanVerdict) and the 5/day desktop quota default come from csd.proto and features.cc; the changed step is highlighted.

interactive.rationale: Pipeline toggle re-renders the steps; a nine-control branch explorer maps conditions to documented reasons; real innerText measurement of this page and fetch+parse of sibling pages.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Delivers the promised step-through, explorer, text measurement and false-positive guidance.

edge_cases.rationale: All eight NoInfoReason values reachable; on-device vs server variants; fetch failure path with retry text; explicit statement that evaluation order is not documented.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch; console and network clean; 0px horizontal overflow (after fixes); feature-level conformance panel rendered 4 pass / 0 fail / 3 blocked. The scan itself is never observable from a page, so no verdict evidence exists by design. Explorer walked through MODEL OUTPUT (server and on-device), SERVER_SIDE_MODEL_EXCEED_QUOTA at 5 used, ON_DEVICE_MODEL_UNAVAILABLE, TEXT_TOO_SHORT, ALLOWLISTED, EMPTY_TEXT, no-trigger and not-ESB; self text 6456 chars; fetched enrollment page 1986 chars. A real 87px mobile overflow (unbreakable enum names in the steps) was found and fixed, re-measured 0px.

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts the explorer never emits a scam verdict code and that innerText measurement returns text.

design_system.rationale: Tokens only; on-device emerald-dark, server blue labels.

accessibility.rationale: Native fieldsets, range with <output>, live status for outcomes and measurements.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Verified at both viewports after the overflow fix.

openQuestions.title: TEXT_TOO_SHORT threshold
openQuestions.detail: The threshold is not public; if Chromium source exposes it (for example as a feature param), replace the 'very little text' wording and the <30-word heuristic with the real value.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Group related radios in fieldset/legend with visible labels; avoid custom controls when native ones work.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All option groups are fieldset+legend native radios/checkboxes; range input paired with an <output>.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Collapse grids on narrow viewports, wrap long tokens, keep 44px targets.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Single-column below 760-900px, overflow-wrap:anywhere on code and enum names, 44px controls; measured 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce discrete outcomes in polite status/log regions; native labelled controls; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Outcomes in role=status/role=log; native buttons, radios, checkboxes with visible labels and focus-visible outlines.

summary: Source-grounded comparison of the on-device and server pipelines with a no-verdict branch explorer and real text measurement.
